# opnsense_haproxy_settings (Resource)

Manages global OPNsense HAProxy settings. The built-in singleton is adopted automatically on first apply; explicit import remains supported.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `close_spread_time` (String) Optional connection close spread time.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the HAProxy service is enabled.
- `graceful_stop` (Boolean) Whether HAProxy uses graceful stop behavior.
- `hard_stop_after` (String) Maximum graceful shutdown duration, such as `60s`.
- `seamless_reload` (Boolean) Whether seamless reload is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed singleton identifier `haproxy_settings`.
